linux_overlay.owner_decision: Unresolved originals must not be present in Linux packages or the Linux source tarball; Linux packages carry original MIT replacements instead, except rating_tmdb, which carries TMDB's official attribution logo (owner decision 2026-10-14)
linux_overlay.mechanism: tools/linux/packaging/source_policy.py (applied once after build.source_tree() by both canonical builds: build.py native/bootstrap and the seeded canonical_from_seed.py) substitutes tools/linux/packaging/artwork/overlay/<path> for each tracked target and records the overlay sha256 in source-files.json
linux_overlay.gate: tools/linux/packaging/artwork_contract.py requires each replacement hash at its packaged path and rejects all 47 original byte sequences at any JAR path
linux_overlay.tmdb_attribution: Owner decision 2026-10-14: rating_tmdb carries TMDB's official "Primary full (blue)" attribution logo, because TMDB's terms require applications using its data or images to attribute TMDB and https://www.themoviedb.org/about/logos-attribution provides logos for that purpose. The SVG is vendored unmodified at tools/linux/packaging/artwork/vendor/tmdb/blue_square_2.svg (sha256 d537fb228cf3ded904ef09b136fe3fec72548ebc1fea3fbbd1ad9e36364db38b, retrieved 2026-10-14) and rendered to the 67x48 PNG with uniform scale and transparent padding only. License: TMDB-attribution-terms, not MIT. Use is limited to attribution; no endorsement, certification or broader trademark permission is claimed.
linux_overlay.not_claimed: No trademark permission, endorsement, rights clearance of the originals or publication approval
